commands.name: redcap_gate_before_implementation
commands.command: .redcap/runtime/bin/redcap gate --task "RedCap E2E implementation: local full-stack simplified TRPG activity organizing platform with event list, character/player info, join flow, API, frontend, validation evidence" --risk-level medium --boundary-cwd "$PWD" --project-workspace "$PWD"
commands.summary: Decision optional; review_mode strategy_review; boundary_mode external-workspace.

commands.name: unit_and_api_tests
commands.summary: Node test runner passed 6 tests: event list, event detail, join success, duplicate rejection, malformed join rejection, and frontend shell.

commands.name: validation_script
commands.summary: Validation script ran npm test and passed 6/6 tests.

commands.name: local_http_smoke
commands.command: node -e "Promise.all([fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health').then(r=>r.json()), fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3000/').then(r=>r.text())]).then(([h, html])=>{ console.log(JSON.stringify({health:h, htmlIncludesActivityBoard: html.includes('Activity Board'), htmlIncludesJoinForm: html.includes('joinForm')}, null, 2)); })"
commands.summary: Health endpoint returned ok=true; frontend HTML included Activity Board and joinForm.

commands.name: redcap_completion_claim_gate
commands.command: .redcap/runtime/bin/redcap gate --task "RedCap E2E implementation: local full-stack simplified TRPG activity organizing platform with event list, character/player info, join flow, API, frontend, validation evidence" --risk-level medium --boundary-cwd "$PWD" --project-workspace "$PWD" --completion-claim "terminal_complete: scoped local TRPG activity platform deliverable implemented with API, frontend, tests, architecture and RedCap evidence; not claiming full RedCap revival" --capability-status operational
commands.summary: Completion semantics allowed the scoped terminal_complete claim with capability status operational.
